nodes.label: VetoThemeProvider
nodes.rationale: Renders no element of its own so it never disturbs a layout. Appearance is carried by the data-veto-theme attribute on <html>, maintained by the service; the component only supplies overrides and triggers re-renders on theme change. JS interop for InitializeAsync is deferred to OnAfterRenderAsync's firstRender because it is unavailable while prerendering.
